comment: EMC per 1000 mB of the fluids the Pack lists, for the Prestige mod (ProjectE can't hold fluid values) and its GT recipe mapper. GENERATED by docs/research/emc-pricing/generate.py: edit hand_values.json there and re-run it. Water is the one free fluid. Lava and milk are ProjectE's bucket values minus the empty bucket, steam is nominal; fluids GT makes from nothing or water alone are priced per tier, anchored at lava (LV 64, MV 128, HV 256); nitrogen is its cost from air (#81); a floored material's molten fluid is its floor per 144 mB. Every other fluid is unlisted: the GT recipe mapper derives it from its recipes (#72). A filled bucket is worth the empty bucket plus its fluid (custom_emc.json).
